 Ana de Armas Embraces a More Sensual Look at the Latin Recording Academy Gala
 Posted by Catherine Kallon 
 Ana de Armas accompanied her boyfriend, Rawayana frontman Beto Montenegro, to the 2026 Latin Recording Academy Person of the Year Gala in Las Vegas, where Daddy Yankee was honoured for his contribution to Latin music.
 John Parra/Getty Images for The Latin Recording Academy 
 She may have been a plus-one, but she stole the spotlight in a Wiederhoeft Spring 2027 cap-sleeve moiré corset and embroidered Chantilly lace maxi skirt, embracing the hyper-femininity and Joseph Wiederhoeft’s fascination with corsetry that have become signatures of the label.
 The corset gives the look its shape, while the sheer lace skirt introduces a more provocative element, with the embroidery and beaded fringe shimmering under the lights.
 John Parra/Getty Images for The Latin Recording Academy 
 This feels like a rare sensual moment from Ana, one we don’t often get from her Louis Vuitton outings. It’s a welcome change of pace, and one that feels perfectly suited to this red carpet.
 A Fiametta pear bezel Tennis necklace and matching bracelet in white gold completed her look.
 Styled by Samantha McMillen.
